fundamentals.input_semantics: Itoflow load_fundamentals_history available_date with publication_lag_days=1; derived PE/ROE/margins; no current screener snapshot backfill
fundamentals.unavailable_reason: Unavailable for held-out scoring: after point-in-time availability filtering, the valid PE cross-section was below Itoflow build_value_signal minimum of 20 symbols on required monthly decision dates; no current snapshot was backfilled.

benchmark: voo_buy_hold uses Itoflow provider Close (adjusted series; raw_close retained in OHLCV artifacts) with the same commission and date window.
fundamental_decision_dates: First available trading date of each calendar month; scores use only fundamentals with available_date strictly before each date.
news: Not used; this suite is independent of the unavailable GDELT feed.
